Держись! = hang in there!. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hold on; to stick with'.

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё будет хорошо.

Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ычно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: А в каких местах он обычно пьёт?
examples.trans: And in what places does he usually drink?

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'метить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to celebrate, to note', paired with 'отмечать'.

examples.text: Я хотел отметить день рождения вместе.
examples.trans: I wanted to celebrate the birthday together.

meanings.note: With verbs: очень люблю. Core Russian adv meaning 'very, very much' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'готовить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to prepare, to get ready', paired with 'подготавливать'.

examples.text: Мы всё подготовили и прилетели на сделку.
examples.trans: We got everything ready and flew in for the deal.

meanings.note: + dative: 'позвони мне' = call me. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'звонить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to call, to phone', paired with 'звонить'.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: Поздравляю! = congratulations!. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'здравлять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to congratulate', paired with 'поздравить'.
